name: langfuse-oss-prisma-cli
description: The Prisma CLI the langfuse-oss web image runs its Postgres migrations with (web/entrypoint.sh: prisma migrate deploy). The version upstream's web Dockerfile installs at v3.194.1, here from the committed package-lock.json (sha512 integrity). Regenerate: npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
